While an account is signed in its row is updated on every 1-point rise in its weekly used percent (and its 5h percent and resets with it), and the meter is read again whenever the weekly percent has moved by a point. Shown in 'orchestrator accounts' (one row each: email, weekly % used / % left, weekly reset, 5h % used, 5h reset, last read) and as an Accounts card on the dashboard. Stored in %APPDATA%\MindAttic\MindAttic.Orchestrator\accounts.json, separate from the per-account token ledger.
